Intersecting results with `{ __tags?: { sourceString } }` cost one type per
key and, for the inline translator's ReactNode output, one per ReactNode
member. Translators now return plain string, readonly string[] or ReactNode,
so the source string no longer shows in the result type on hover.

store-manager-ui (tsc 7.0.2, checkers 1): 1,283,750 -> 1,237,164 types,
2.67 GB -> 2.61 GB. Diagnostics unchanged.
